description: This file contains unit tests for the SessionFilters component of the chat UI in the ai.openclaw.app project. It tests session decision logic based on timestamps and session keys.

classes.name: SessionFiltersTest
classes.description: Test class for validating session selection logic in chat application's UI.

methods.name: sessionChoicesPreferMainAndRecent
methods.description: Tests that the session choices prioritize 'main' and recent sessions based on timestamps.

methods.name: sessionChoicesIncludeCurrentWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that the current session is included in the choices if it is missing from the session list.
